reason: If the core app is free, I would download it once on Wi-Fi and let my child use the free part. In our family it is the grandmother who pays for the child's learning, and she gives money for a real tutor or a kindergarten course, not for a subscription on my phone.
objection: The app is probably big and our mobile internet is slow and limited, and I do not know what PRO gives that the free part does not. Paying every month for something on a phone does not feel like a real gift to my mother.
would_change_my_mind: Other mothers in our kindergarten Telegram group saying their child actually learned the letters with it, plus a one-time yearly card I could give grandma to pay as a gift for school preparation.
